messages.text: Wire the inheritance in completion like this. In `diagnosisService.complete`, read the last completed, non-archived diagnosis of the company (excluding the one being completed) and build `previous = { diagnosisId, plan: result.plan, progress: await actionProgressRepository.findByDiagnosis(id) }` (or `null` when there is none). Call `inheritActionProgress(newResult.plan, previous)` from shared/domain/actionProgress.ts: it returns `{ actions, closed }` where `actions` has exactly one entry per plan key, in plan order, with `{ actionKey, status, dueDate, ownerRole, note, inheritedFromId }` (inheritedFromId = previous.diagnosisId for a repeated key, null for a new one) and `closed` lists the previous keys that do not repeat (informational: 'closed' is derived, never stored). Pass `actions` out of the `build` callback of `completeDraft` and, inside the same `$transaction`, call `tx.actionProgress.createMany({ data: toNewActionProgressRows(id, actions) })` (exported by server/repositories/actionProgressRepository.ts) only after the conditional `findFirst({ status: 'draft' })` succeeded, so a second Concluir finds no draft and creates no rows. A version 1 previous diagnosis with no rows still counts as 'continues' (inherits the default 'A fazer') for the keys that repeat.

ActionProgressRepository (createActionProgressRepository(prisma)): findByDiagnosis(id), findByDiagnoses(ids), findByCompany(companyId) return ActionProgressRecord[] ordered by actionKey (the service must order by `result.plan`), each with `status`, `dueDate` (YYYY-MM-DD|null), `ownerRole`, `note`, `inheritedFromId`, `inheritedFromCompletedAt` (Date|null, for 'Continua do diagnóstico de {data}'), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. save(diagnosisId, actionKey, patch) is an upsert: `undefined` leaves a field alone, `null` clears dueDate/ownerRole/note, a missing row (version 1 diagnosis) is created with the defaults plus the patch, and a racing first edit retries as an update. It does NOT check the plan: `plan_closed` (409), `diagnosis_not_found` (404) and that the actionKey belongs to the diagnosis' `result.plan` are the service's job. Stored text that is not a known state/role/date reads back as the default instead of throwing. Deleting a company or a diagnosis cascades to its rows; deleting the diagnosis an action was inherited from keeps the later rows and sets `inheritedFromId` to null.

For server/validation/actionSchemas.ts use `ACTION_STATUSES`, `ACTION_OWNER_ROLES`, `ACTION_NOTE_MAX_LENGTH` (500) from shared/domain/actionProgress.ts and `isValidIsoDate` from shared/format/dates.ts (real calendar date, years 1900-2999, `YYYY-MM-DD`). For 'overdue' (RULE-ra-06) call `isActionOverdue({ status, dueDate }, today)` with `today = localIsoDate(now())` (local calendar day, text comparison); it returns false for no deadline or any malformed date and never throws.

shared/format/dates.ts exports for DateField/ActionEditDialog: `maskDateInput(raw, caret?, previous?)` -> `{ value, caret }` (same contract as `maskCnpjInput`), `getDateError(value)` (null for empty or a complete real date, else `DATE_INVALID_MESSAGE` = 'Data inválida. Use o formato DD/MM/AAAA.'), `dateInputToIso(value)` (DD/MM/AAAA -> YYYY-MM-DD or null), `isoToDateInput(iso)` (YYYY-MM-DD -> DD/MM/AAAA or ''). shared/content/actionProgressOptions.ts exports `ACTION_STATUS_LABELS`, `ACTION_OWNER_ROLE_LABELS`, `ACTION_STATUS_OPTIONS` and `ACTION_OWNER_ROLE_OPTIONS` ({ value, label }[]) with the stored keys todo/in_progress/done/not_applicable and owner/sales_team/marketing_team/consultant/other.

Schema change: new model ActionProgress (table action_progress, unique (diagnosis_id, action_key), FK diagnosis_id ON DELETE CASCADE, FK inherited_from_id ON DELETE SET NULL) and two relation fields on Diagnosis (no column change in diagnoses). I ran `pnpm exec prisma generate`, so server/generated/prisma already has `prisma.actionProgress` and the compound key `diagnosisId_actionKey`; any checkout that has a stale generated client must run it again. Existing API suites still pass with the migration: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/diagnosisRoutes.test.ts tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts tests/api/backupRoutes.test.ts tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts` -> 191 passed. Remaining phase checks to run after the siblings land: `pnpm build`, `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/actionProgress.test.ts tests/unit/dates.test.ts tests/api/actionRoutes.test.ts tests/api/diagnosisRoutes.test.ts tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts tests/unit/reportModel.test.ts tests/unit/evolutionDocument.test.ts tests/unit/portfolioDocument.test.ts`, `node scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs`, `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts tests/e2e/result.spec.ts tests/e2e/history.spec.ts`, then the Play dev-link walkthrough (change state and undo, complete a second diagnosis and see the inheritance, export the PDF with the progress).
